summary: F1 is fixed. With the lock chip at inset 36px, every locked stage card at all seven sizes keeps the chip clear of the stage tag and of the medals pill. Chapters 1, 2, 4 and 5 were checked on the seeded save (75 locked cards in all). The tag gap is 4 to 10 px and the medals gap is 6.6 to 105 px. At 844x390 the gap is now 6.6 px, where before the chip covered the pill by 1.4 px. Every tag is whole. F2 is fixed at 667x375 and 844x390: the narrower lesson pill now ends left of her face box and is clear of the wallets, the news chip and the dock, and its words wrap cleanly. One minor remains, carried over from F2. At 1024x768 the 380 px cap still applies, so the change does not narrow the pill there. The pill's box reaches into the padded edge of her face box: by about 15 px for Ruri on the seeded save and 1.5 px on a fresh save. The pill's rounded end stays clear of her hair and face pixels. The change is CSS only: no sim or protocol change is needed.

findings.title: At 1024x768 the lesson pill's box still reaches into the padded edge of her face box
findings.detail: max-width is min(380px, calc(40vw - 24px)). At 1024 wide, 40vw - 24 is 385.6 px, so the 380 px cap applies, as it did before the change, and the pill still spans x 24 to 404 (y 160 to 214). On the seeded save (Ruri), window.__sakura.home.placement().face starts at x 389.3, y 183.2, an overlap of about 15 px by 31 px of box. On a fresh save it starts at x 402.5, an overlap of 1.5 px. In the zoomed crop the pill's rounded right end sits in the box's padded margin, left of her hair, and never covers her face. Capping the pill at about 360 px, or at calc(40vw - 64px), from 1024 wide would close it. It is not a blocker.
